squiggle.sensitivity.markdownDescription: How trigger-happy the explainer is, from **Zen** (0 — stays quiet until an error is clearly real) to **Nitpicky** (100 — speaks up early and often). Higher values also start covering warnings and info hints.

squiggle.patience.markdownDescription: How long to wait for an error to stop changing before explaining it, in milliseconds. Errors flicker while you type, so a little patience avoids noise. **Instant** is 0; **Deep zen** is 5s. Only used when `squiggle.explainOn` is set to `auto`.

squiggle.narration.markdownDescription: How much hand-holding in explanations, from **Pro** (0 — terse: what it means and the fix) to **Baby** (100 — spells everything out, with reassurance).

squiggle.contextLines.markdownDescription: How many lines of surrounding code are sent along with an error to make the explanation better. 0 sends just the error line — nothing extra leaves your computer.

enumDescriptions: Automatically, once an error stops changing for a moment.
Only when you save the file.
Only when you ask (hover or right-click → Explain this error).
squiggle.explainOn.description: What starts an explanation: automatically, only when you save, or only when you ask. `squiggle.patience` only applies to `auto`.

squiggle.statusBar.description: Show a connected / offline indicator for the core in the VS Code status bar.
